nina: Heads-up: launch cadence final check. Need prod docs URL, changelog snippet, and confirm announce timing so we can lock the email send + webinar CTA. cc @omar @ruth
omar: Changelog merged -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/commit/def456. Snippet: - Reduced tail latency via KV cache fixes; - Adaptive batching for short prompts (~15% cost reduction); - Private KMS beta.
ruth: Docs will be live at https://docs.redwood.ai/release/mar25 by 09:30 PT after CDN invalidation. I'll paste prod link when live.
nina: Proposed schedule: publish 10:10 PT, email 10:15 PT, social blitz at 10:20 PT, webinar CTA visible at 10:25 PT. Can we do a 10-min smoke before publish?
omar: Ops: yes. Canary 10:00-10:10 PT (10% traffic), ramp 10:10-10:30. Rollback if errors >1% for 3m or p95 +200ms. We'll keep tracing for 60m.
zack: Lead form /launch-interest ready. UTM: utm_source=announce&utm_campaign=mar25_launch. Will tag leads release_mar25 automatically.
deploy-bot: deploy-status: canary scheduled 2026-03-25T17:00:00Z job/901 queued.
nina: Great. Locking copy after changelog snippet inserted. @ruth paste prod docs link here when CDN done.
ruth: CDN invalidated. Prod docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/mar25 (final).
nina: All set. I'll queue social and email. Thanks team :rocket:
__notes: Concise marketing-engineering handoff thread with deployment bot message and UTMs.
